units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 4:8:3">Y. R. Hash. IV, 59ᶜ</cite> bot. (ref. to <he>רנתי</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 17:1">Ps. XVII, 1</cite>) <he>זו ר׳ תורה</he> that is the chanting at studying the Law; Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c. <he>רִינּוּנָהּ של תורה</he>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 841:2">Yalk. Ps. 841</cite> <he>שהוא עוסק ברינונה של תורה</he> he is engaged in the study of the Law.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 33:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXIII</cite> <he>ר׳ של צדיקים</he> the singing (praise) of the righteous; a. e.
